description_zh: 将一个账号组中的规则复制到另外一个账号组中
name: CopyConfigRules

parameters.help_en: The rule IDs. Separate multiple rule IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 规则ID列表。多个规则ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: src_config_rule_ids

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the account group to which the rules belong.

For more information about how to obtain the ID of an account group, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.help_zh:
待复制规则所属账号组ID。

关于如何获取账号组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.name: src_aggregator_id

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the destination account groups into which the rules are replicated. Separate multiple account group IDs with commas (,).

If you leave this parameter empty, the compliance packages are replicated into the same account group
parameters.help_zh:
规则复制到的账号组ID。多个账号组ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔。

该值为空，表示将规则复制到当前账号
parameters.name: des_aggregator_ids

CopyRulesResult.description_en:
Indicates whether the rules are replicated. Valid values:

true
false
CopyRulesResult.description_zh:
规则的复制结果。取值：
true：成功。
fasle：失败
